isolation.why: hermetic: runs arlo's own grounding tests in a throwaway clone; stdlib-only, starts no daemons, binds no host ports, writes no shared state. The LOM is deliberately NOT part of the distribution: the model that runs the skill is resolved in the operator's own context along the resource gradient (see decisions.md), so the artifact neither carries nor provisions a model. What transfers is the skill plus the model-agnostic grounding core.
